to.shell_command: P=$(osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to unix id of first process whose frontmost is true'); [ -n "$P" ] && kill -9 "$P"

B=$(osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to bundle identifier of first process whose frontmost is true'); P=$(osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to unix id of first process whose frontmost is true'); [ -n "$P" ] && kill -9 "$P"; [ -n "$B" ] && { sleep 0.7; open -b "$B"; }

osascript -e '
set prev to the clipboard
set the clipboard to "⌘"
tell application "System Events"
  keystroke "v" using command down
  delay 0.1
end tell
set the clipboard to prev'
